'''Rentor''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Rentor system/Legends|Rentor system]] of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions']] [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Space]]. It was linked via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Csilla system/Legends|Csilla]] and [[Jamiron system/Legends|Jamiron systems]]. Rentor's surface featured [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] as well as [[Water/Legends|icebergs]] that slowly cruised the currents of the open seas. The [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] of the Chiss Ascendancy had [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] Rentor, establishing settlements atop the world's icebergs.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rentor was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square F-8.<ref name="TEA" />
